messages:
elaine: Quick sync 00 proposing a new rollout metadata field 'ingress_hint' — a weak, control-plane-only preference for which ingress subgroup should serve a pinned model. Goal: reduce cross-gateway KV cache misses for hot tenants without hard-routing.

samir: Need precise resolver semantics. If capacity_ok() fails, hint must not override autoscaling/placement.

matt: Prefer an integer priority (0-10) instead of float; simpler to reason about and log. Also validation: prefix 'ingress-' and ascii/dash chars only.

maria: Ops: when ingress_hint changes we should apply a transition window (default 10m) to avoid K/V thrash. Also expose dashboards: ingress-locality-hit-rate, kv-cache-miss-rate, p95-latency.

ops-bot: schema-checker: pushed draft 'rollout-meta-v1.5-ingress' to staging; 2 legacy consumers failing.

elaine: Example (text): {"pin":"search-v7","ingress_hint":"ingress-eu-a1","ingress_priority":"7","transition_minutes":"10","telemetry_opt_in":"ingress_hint"}  — note: control-plane only, clients ignore.

samir: Resolver pseudo: if not capacity_ok(candidate): continue; score = base(candidate); if candidate.ingress_id == hint.id: score += hint.priority*2; else if candidate.region == hint.region: score += hint.priority; // tie-breaker only

matt: Reject unknown ingress ids at write time by default. Allow an 'allow_unregistered_hint' boolean for experiments (must generate audit log).

maria: Runbook: on mass hint changes ramp updates per-tenant (rate-limit), watch kv-cache-miss >20% and revert.

elaine: Action items: matt -> schema + validator; samir -> resolver changes behind flag + unit tests; maria -> migration ramp/runbook + dashboards; ops-bot -> re-run schema-checker after PRs. Follow-up once CI is green. :thumbsup:
